Summary: TICKET-ADV048 — Create the multi-module Maven project
Description: GOAL: five-module Maven reactor building end-to-end with ./mvnw -pl backend clean install. DONE WHEN: parent backend/pom.xml has <packaging>pom</packaging> + <modules> naming common, domain, repository, service, api. Each child pom declares <parent> but not its own groupId/version. Root ./mvnw -pl backend clean install exits 0, reports five reactor builds.

Summary: TICKET-ADV049 — Spring profiles: dev / uat / prod
Description: GOAL: three profiles so the same JAR boots H2 in dev, Postgres in UAT, secrets-driven Postgres in prod. DONE WHEN: application.yml defaults active profile to dev via SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE fallback. dev = in-memory H2 in Postgres-compat mode. uat/prod use Postgres dialect; prod credentials all from env vars that fail fast if unset. open-in-view false; liquibase change-log has classpath: prefix; sql.init.mode never.

GOAL: Trade JPA entity with lazy relations to Counterparty/Instrument + Spring Data auditing + Envers. DONE WHEN: Trade in domain module, @Entity @Table(indexes) @EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener) @Audited. counterparty/instrument @ManyToOne(LAZY, optional=false) @JoinColumn. status @Enumerated(STRING) default PENDING. createdAt @CreatedDate updatable=false; modifiedAt @LastModifiedDate. @EnableJpaAuditing config in api. equals/hashCode hand-written on id only (no Lombok @Data).

Summary: TICKET-ADV051 — Instrument entity with JSONB metadata
Description: GOAL: map Instrument including Map<String,Object> metadata stored as JSONB on Postgres, CLOB on H2. DONE WHEN: fields id, symbol (unique), name, assetClass (enum STRING), currency (len 3), metadata. metadata @Type(JsonBinaryType) @Column(columnDefinition=jsonb). dev H2 URL includes MODE=PostgreSQL so column type round-trips. Save+reload with arbitrary metadata keys yields the same map.

Summary: TICKET-ADV052 — Hibernate Envers on the Trade entity
Description: GOAL: verify Envers writes one row per committed Trade change to trades_aud + expose two query methods. DONE WHEN: after 3 updates to one trade, trades_aud has 4 rows for that id (1 insert + 3 updates), revinfo has matching REV ids + timestamps. TradeHistoryService.revisionsFor(tradeId) returns revision numbers. snapshotAt(tradeId, rev) returns entity state at that revision. Both @Transactional(readOnly=true).

GOAL: TradeRequest, TradeResponse, generic PagedResponse<T> so controllers never leak JPA entities. DONE WHEN: TradeRequest record with @NotBlank/@NotNull/@DecimalMin/@PastOrPresent. TradeResponse record with flat counterparty/instrument fields, no nested objects. PagedResponse<T> record with items, page, size, totalElements, totalPages. Static factory of(Page<E>, Function<E,T>) maps page content via the supplied function.

GOAL: compile-time Spring-managed TradeMapper mapping Trade to/from TradeRequest/TradeResponse. DONE WHEN: @Mapper(componentModel=spring, unmappedTargetPolicy=ERROR). toResponse maps counterparty.id/name + instrument.id/symbol to flat fields, enum status to String via @Named helper. toEntity ignores id, counterparty, instrument, status, createdAt, modifiedAt. maven-compiler-plugin has mapstruct-processor in annotationProcessorPaths. TradeMapperImpl generated after compile.

GOAL: Spring Data repo with derived findByTradeRef + JPQL findByFilters supporting optional date range/status/counterparty. DONE WHEN: TradeRepository extends JpaRepository<Trade,Long> + JpaSpecificationExecutor<Trade>. findByTradeRef(String) returns Optional<Trade>. findByFilters(from, to, status, counterpartyId, Pageable) returns Page<Trade> via @Query using the (:param IS NULL OR ...) idiom. Smoke test returns seed trades in the date range.

GOAL: replace (:param IS NULL OR ...) with composable JPA Specifications, each independently testable. DONE WHEN: final TradeSpecification (private ctor) exposes tradeDateBetween, hasStatus, forCounterparty, refLike. Each returns Specification<Trade> and short-circuits to cb.conjunction() when arg null/blank. Query service composes with Specification.where().and().and() + findAll(spec, pageable). Tests for 'date range only' and 'all four' both return the right rows.

Summary: TICKET-ADV057 — Pagination on the list endpoint
Description: GOAL: GET /v1/trades with optional filters + Spring Pageable, capped to a sane default page size. DONE WHEN: TradeController @RestController at /v1/trades. GET accepts from/to/status/counterpartyId as optional params, from/to via @DateTimeFormat(ISO.DATE). Pageable has @PageableDefault(size=20, sort=tradeDate, DESC). Returns PagedResponse<TradeResponse> via PagedResponse.of(page, mapper::toResponse). ?page=0&size=5 returns 200 with a stable JSON envelope.

GOAL: springdoc OpenAPI exposing Swagger UI at /api/swagger-ui.html with public + admin groups. DONE WHEN: OpenApiConfig declares an OpenAPI bean (title, description, version, contact, bearerAuth HTTP/bearer/JWT scheme). Two GroupedOpenApi beans: public matching /v1/trades/** + /v1/recon/**; admin matching /v1/admin/** + /actuator/**. Under dev, swagger-ui.html loads + switches groups. GET /api/v1/api-docs/public returns public-group JSON.

GOAL: replace Boot's default DataSource health indicator with one owning its SQL, timeout, details. DONE WHEN: @Component(reconxDatabase) extends AbstractHealthIndicator. Runs SELECT 1 against the DataSource with a 2s statement timeout. Success reports up() + query=SELECT 1 + elapsedMs. Failure reports down(exception) + query string. GET /actuator/health shows reconxDatabase: UP under components.

GOAL: conditional Kafka health indicator registering only when spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers is set. DONE WHEN: @Component(reconxKafka) extends AbstractHealthIndicator, gated by @ConditionalOnProperty(spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers). Creates AdminClient with 2s request + 3s default API timeout. Success calls describeCluster(), records clusterId + nodeCount. Under dev (no Kafka) absent from /actuator/health; under UAT present + UP.

GOAL: human-readable logs in dev, JSON in uat/prod, per-request correlationId (+optional tradeRef) via SLF4J MDC. DONE WHEN: logback-spring.xml with two <springProfile> blocks — dev plain pattern including %X{correlationId:-} %X{tradeRef:-}; uat,prod LogstashEncoder includeMdc=true + service field. @Component @Order(1) MdcFilter reads X-Correlation-Id (or generates UUID) + X-Trade-Ref, puts both in MDC before chain.doFilter, MDC.clear() in finally. Request with X-Correlation-Id: foo-123 logs foo-123 in dev.

GOAL: application/problem+json responses for every domain exception, validation failure, uncaught error via ProblemDetail. DONE WHEN: GlobalExceptionHandler @RestControllerAdvice in api. TradeNotFoundException -> 404 (type trade-not-found, title Trade not found, timestamp). DuplicateTradeRefException -> 409 (type duplicate-trade-ref). ReconException -> 422 with custom reconBreakId. MethodArgumentNotValidException -> 400 with all field errors joined into detail. Any uncaught Exception -> 500 with a safe generic message, logged at error.
